name: Lake Tschida - Schatz's Point Campground (Grant County)
note: Primitive Lake Tschida sites scattered singly over Schatz's Point, a grassy peninsula on the south shore with a restroom, shelter, playground, boat ramp and ADA fishing pier. Sites are grass spots with a table and no pads; 2, 4, 20 and 21 sit at the water, and 16 is tent only. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: laketschida.org/schatzs-pt%2Fhidden-shelter (BOR/JJDA map) + schatzs-primitive booking page and Peek program mMjM selling single nights (16 marked tent only) -> real drive-in campground. Horse camp Hidden Shelter is drawn on the same map ~450 m W of site 4 with its own road and trails running west and south, and the operator says it is 'the only campground at Lake Tschida that will accommodate horses' -> horse area explicitly separate. Separate from the Southside complex (~1.1 km E) and Sled Creek (~1.9 km W). Operator Lake Tschida Recreation (Tri-Cities Joint Job Development Authority, the managing partner with the Bureau of Reclamation; same operator and ownership as 6025 Rimrock), laketschida.org read 2026-11-12. 'Camping unit' covers motor homes and pull-type campers (campground rules). Horse rule passes: the Hidden Shelter page says it is 'the only campground at Lake Tschida that will accommodate horses' and it is a separate area. Long-stay test 4: every site is sold by the night on Peek; the private cabin and trailer permittee areas are separate lease areas, not campground sites. Public (local): no price gate or presence rule.
waterfront_evidence: 2026-11-12: the official map puts 20 and 21 on the point's south shore by the boat ramp, 2 on the east bay and 4 on the inner bay; the operator's Peek photos show those four tables on open grass a few metres from the water; Esri World Imagery (z18 at 46.6040,-101.8712) shows ~20 m of open mown grass with single trees between the shore road and the water. The other sites are set back across the point. Lakefront on 2, 4, 20 and 21 only. Dam ~4.7 km E.
fees_source: https://laketschida.org/camping-fees ('$14 nightly fee for a primitive campsite at all campsites'; '$24 nightly fee for electrical campsites.'), read 2026-11-12

sites.note: Primitive 2-4, 7-9, 11-15, 20 and 21 (9 ADA), scattered singly on grass; 16 is tent only and not counted.

sites_source: https://laketschida.org/schatzs-primitive ('SCHATZ'S PRIMITIVE CAMPSITE 16 (Tent Only)'), the Schatz's Point map and Peek photos, read 2026-11-12
facilities_source: https://laketschida.org/schatzs-pt%2Fhidden-shelter map (well water by site 9, ADA), read 2026-11-12

booking.note: Online booking closes 7 days out; inside a week, book by phone with the office. Friday or Saturday arrivals must take two nights between Memorial Day and Labor Day weekends. Unreserved sites are first come, first served with envelopes at the self-registration kiosks (cash or check).

booking_source: https://laketschida.org/campground-information ('7 DAY RULE ... If you want to make a reservation less than 7 days in advance you must call the office'; 'the minimum of 2 NIGHTS is required between Memorial Day weekend and Labor Day weekend'; 'No campsite may be occupied for more than 14 consecutive days out of 30 consecutive days'); https://laketschida.org/camping-fees ('camping envelopes are provided at self-registration Kiosks ... First Come First Serve'); https://laketschida.org/general-information ('all unreserved sites are available on a first come first serve basis'); the area's Peek booking program; read 2026-11-12
flags: Horse rule: Hidden Shelter Horse Campground is ~450 m from site 4 on the same map; passed because the operator states it is the only campground taking horses and it has its own road and trails. AWH may want to look.
General information says a dump station is 'at the Schatz Point Area', but the area maps put it at Schatz Station in the Southside complex ~1 km E, so dump is not given here.
Grass sites with no posted size; kept under the unclear-pad rule.
No season is published for any Lake Tschida area.
curation_note: ND lead 9 (2026-11-12): Hidden Shelter horse camp ~450 m W, explicitly the only horse campground. The 'Schatz Point' dump is at Schatz Station in the Southside complex. --Claude
